equity.equity_measurement: Pairwise Z-tests between subgroup age-adjusted prevalences; reported contrasts are extreme categories (e.g., <100% vs ≥400% FPL, less than high school vs bachelor's). AI/AN, Asian and NHPI are collapsed into non-Hispanic other; insurance type reported separately by age <65 and ≥65.

notes: Design inferred as cross-sectional (national survey; not named). Education, poverty and urbanicity results are reported only as two-group contrasts, so no groupwise entries. The rise from the cited 1999 NHIS estimate (0.9%) is not tested.
view_issues: Table column is labeled age-adjusted %, yet it holds the crude total and age-group rows, which cannot be age-adjusted. Summary says 'suburban', text 'outside the central city', but 1.4% matches the MSA noncentral city row only.
